<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_CarService" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/car-service">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SuccessfulService" name="Successful service"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Notification" name="Service notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ServiceRequest" name="Service request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_StatusUpdates" name="Status updates by email"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepairDone" name="Repair done"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Payment" name="Payment through the app"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CarService">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PoliceApp" name="Police app" processRef="Process_PoliceApp"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="You" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ServiceFacility" name="Car service facility" processRef="Process_ServiceFacility"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ServiceSuccess" name="Successful service" sourceRef="Task_EnterNextService" targetRef="Start_SuccessfulService" messageRef="Message_SuccessfulService"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Notification" name="Service notification" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCustomer" targetRef="Start_Notification" messageRef="Message_Notification"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ServiceRequestToPolice" name="Service request" sourceRef="Task_SendServiceRequest" targetRef="Event_ServiceRequest" messageRef="Message_ServiceRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ServiceRequestToFacility" name="Service request" sourceRef="Task_SendServiceRequest" targetRef="Start_ServiceRequest" messageRef="Message_ServiceRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StatusUpdates" name="Status updates by email" sourceRef="Task_SendStatusUpdates" targetRef="Task_ReceiveStatusUpdates" messageRef="Message_StatusUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RepairDone" name="Repair done" sourceRef="Task_NotifyRepairDone" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRepairDone" messageRef="Message_RepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Payment" name="Payment through the app" sourceRef="Task_PayThroughApp" targetRef="Task_ReceivePayment" messageRef="Message_Payment"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_PoliceApp" name="Car service reminders" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_SuccessfulService" name="Successful service">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_SuccessfulService" messageRef="Message_SuccessfulService"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ServiceNecessary" name="Service necessary">
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_ServiceNecessary">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${serviceNecessary}</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckRegistration" name="Check if the car is still registered"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Registered" name="Car still registered?"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_NotifyCustomer" name="Notify you"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_ServiceOrDeadline" name="Service or 30 days" eventGatewayType="Exclusive" instantiate="false"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ServiceRequest" name="You go to the service">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ServiceRequest" messageRef="Message_ServiceRequest"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ThirtyDays" name="30 days pass">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_ThirtyDays">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P30D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Fine" name="Fine you"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ServiceAttended" name="Service attended"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Fined" name="Fined"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotRegistered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Police_1" sourceRef="Start_SuccessfulService" targetRef="Event_ServiceNecessary"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Police_2" sourceRef="Event_ServiceNecessary" targetRef="Task_CheckRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Police_3" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegistration" targetRef="Gateway_Registered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Police_Registered" name="Registered" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="Task_NotifyCustomer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${carRegistered}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Police_NotRegistered" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="End_NotRegistered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Police_4" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCustomer" targetRef="Gateway_ServiceOrDeadline"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Police_ServiceRequest" sourceRef="Gateway_ServiceOrDeadline" targetRef="Event_ServiceRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Police_ThirtyDays" sourceRef="Gateway_ServiceOrDeadline" targetRef="Event_ThirtyDays"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Police_5" sourceRef="Event_ServiceRequest" targetRef="End_ServiceAttended"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Police_6" sourceRef="Event_ThirtyDays" targetRef="Task_Fine"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Police_7" sourceRef="Task_Fine" targetRef="End_Fined"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Respond to service notification" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Notification" name="Service notification received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Notification" messageRef="Message_Notification"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DecideService" name="Decide whether to go to the service"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GoToService" name="Go to the service?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendServiceRequest" name="Go to the service facility" messageRef="Message_ServiceRequest"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveStatusUpdates" name="Receive status updates by email" messageRef="Message_StatusUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveRepairDone" name="Receive repair-done notice" messageRef="Message_RepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PayThroughApp" name="Pay through the app"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ServiceVisit" name="Service visit completed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotGoing"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_1" sourceRef="Start_Notification" targetRef="Task_DecideService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_2" sourceRef="Task_DecideService" targetRef="Gateway_GoToService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Go" name="Go" sourceRef="Gateway_GoToService" targetRef="Task_SendServiceRequest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${goToService}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_NotGo" name="Do not go" sourceRef="Gateway_GoToService" targetRef="End_NotGoing"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_3" sourceRef="Task_SendServiceRequest" targetRef="Task_ReceiveStatusUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_4" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveStatusUpdates" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRepairDone" targetRef="Task_PayThroughApp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_6" sourceRef="Task_PayThroughApp" targetRef="End_ServiceVisit"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_ServiceFacility" name="Car service" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ServiceRequest" name="Service request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_FacilityServiceRequest" messageRef="Message_ServiceRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterProblems" name="Enter car problems for reference"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ServiceSplit" name=""/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepairCar" name="Repair the car"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendStatusUpdates" name="Send status updates by email" messageRef="Message_StatusUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ServiceJoin" name=""/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyRepairDone" name="Notify you that the repair is done" messageRef="Message_RepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceivePayment" name="Receive payment through the app" messageRef="Message_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterSuccessfulRepair" name="Enter that the repair was successful and you got your Pickerl"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterNextService" name="Enter the time for your next service"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ServiceFacility" name="Service completed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_1" sourceRef="Start_ServiceRequest" targetRef="Task_EnterProblems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_2" sourceRef="Task_EnterProblems" targetRef="Gateway_ServiceSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_Repair" sourceRef="Gateway_ServiceSplit" targetRef="Task_RepairCar"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_Updates" sourceRef="Gateway_ServiceSplit" targetRef="Task_SendStatusUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_3" sourceRef="Task_RepairCar" targetRef="Gateway_ServiceJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_4" sourceRef="Task_SendStatusUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_ServiceJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_5" sourceRef="Gateway_ServiceJoin" targetRef="Task_NotifyRepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_6" sourceRef="Task_NotifyRepairDone" targetRef="Task_ReceivePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_7" sourceRef="Task_ReceivePayment" targetRef="Task_EnterSuccessfulRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_8" sourceRef="Task_EnterSuccessfulRepair" targetRef="Task_EnterNextService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_9" sourceRef="Task_EnterNextService" targetRef="End_ServiceFacility"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
